items.title: 52031_Kenny Clarke oral history interview
items.q: We were the house band. But every Friday, Saturday and Sunday, they would invite a band, but we had to play the show. ... And every week we'd have like Earl, Fletcher, Cab.

ctx.x: We were the house band. But every Friday, Saturday and Sunday, they would invite a band, but we had to play the show. They only played their specialty. And every week we'd have like Earl, Fletcher, Cab.
